name: Portrait wall
description: Tall flowers, birds, gardens and landscapes from Japanese prints, Chinese scrolls and Western painting, chosen to fill the tall companion panel.

works.alt_text: A woodblock print of a bullfinch hanging upside down from a weeping cherry branch full of pale pink blossoms against a deep blue ground, with a poem in calligraphy.
A slender pine trunk rising through a sunny hillside of green grass and flowering shrubs beside a small stream, painted in fine threads of colour.
White and pale lilac peonies with green leaves on a warm golden silk ground, with columns of calligraphy at the top right.
Tall thin pine trees and red-roofed houses in a misty Florida morning, with a lone figure on a path through golden grass.
A woodblock print of a deep blue mountain river winding between steep white snow-covered slopes under a grey sky with falling snow.
A tall tree framing a wide green valley with a white church steeple, a wooden bridge and distant blue mountains under a glowing sunrise.
An ink landscape of a rounded rocky hill with clusters of dotted trees and a small pavilion by the water, with calligraphy in the corner.
A brightly coloured painting of a mill with a red waterwheel and a white waterfall pouring down among blue, green and yellow shapes.
A woodblock print of a small bird perched on a branch of white magnolia flowers with blue-green leaves, beside columns of calligraphy.
A clear river running over pale stones between leafy green trees and a sandy bank, under a blue sky with soft white clouds.
A soft crayon drawing of tree trunks and arching branches in a misty park, in pale greys on cream paper.
A silk painting of a flowering willow and plum tree full of small birds, with peacocks, pheasants and pink and white peonies below.
A snowy field at morning with two small green fir trees, below a dark line of woods and a band of pale green and blue sky.
A pale ink painting of tall bamboo, a thatched pavilion and distant hills by a lake, with long columns of calligraphy above.
A white vase holding a loose bouquet of red, orange, blue and white flowers against a glowing orange and pink background.
Two cows and a young bull resting in a meadow beside a broken tree and a wooden fence, under a large sky of white clouds.
An ink landscape of tall craggy rocks, a small house and a row of trees, drawn with loose grey brushwork on white paper.
A flaming orange autumn tree beside a green meadow and a mill pond, with golden woods and a patch of blue sky.
A soft ink and colour landscape on golden silk with misty mountains, a lake, willows and pines, and a short poem at the top left.
A colour lithograph looking down on a garden of green lawns and bushes in front of a studio with a tall glass window, with a figure resting on a rug on the grass.
A woodblock print of a green Japanese white-eye perched on a slender branch of pink and white blossoms below a deep blue sky.
A tumble of white peonies, white guelder roses, red tulips, blue morning glories and green leaves in a basket against a dark background.
A soft ink painting of a magpie perched on a thin willow branch, with faint willow leaves above on stained pale brown paper.
An etching of a quiet garden with a large leafy tree, a tub of plants and a path leading to a sunny opening beyond.
